parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front panel of the printer.
parts.Functional_description: Used to power on/off or control printer functions such as start, stop, or resume printing.
parts.Movement_description: Moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary plastic button on the printer’s control panel.
parts.Functional_description: Used for specific functions such as canceling a print job or feeding paper.
parts.Movement_description: Moves inward when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another control button made of plastic, part of the printer’s user interface.
parts.Functional_description: May serve as a function selector or maintenance control (e.g., ink check).
parts.Movement_description: Operates via a tactile press mechanism with limited displacement.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged plastic lid located at the top of the printer.
parts.Functional_description: Covers the paper input tray and provides access to the ink cartridge compartment.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates upward around a hinge to open and downward to close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main structural body of the printer made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Houses internal components such as rollers, motors, and circuit boards, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary; serves as the fixed base for all other moving parts.
